name: @gr8ful/spf-cloud
description: spf cloud: one Cloudflare Worker an org deploys into its own account (receipts, and later ingest and dashboard modules), all behind Cloudflare Access. Not published to npm: the root package ships only the minified bundle. hono is deliberately not declared: it resolves from the spf checkout's root node_modules (run `npm ci` at the repo root first), so the Worker and the mounted route factories share one Hono copy.

scripts.test: npm run build:test && npm run bundle && node --test test/*.test.ts
